text: Imagine an App Store for A.I. Built by our people, for our people.
This is the Agent Marketplace. Every agent. One marketplace.
Anyone, in any team, can submit an idea, or share an agent they've already built. In Copilot Studio, with partners, or on our own platforms.
Colleagues discover it. Just describe the task, and the concierge finds the right agent.
Try it. Rate it. Help improve it. Innovation, made accessible to everyone.
The highest-rated contributions rise up a league table, creating visibility, and healthy competition.
Each month, a panel, supported by an evaluation agent, combines community ratings with business impact, and brings the most promising ideas to management.
Winners receive recognition and awards, and support to become robust solutions that entire functions can use.
Governance is built in. Restricted agents stay protected, and an access approval workflow takes care of the rest.
It's a cycle. Share. Experiment. Improve. Scale.
It drives ideation, builds A.I. fluency, and helps us learn from each other.
And as participation grows, individual ideas combine into bigger opportunities, turning creativity across the organisation into shared business value.
The Agent Marketplace. Built by our people, for our people.
